thread:
thomas (AE): Heads-up: NordicBank procurement sent back the order form with several finance and legal asks. They want PO on invoice, VAT handling for EU, and a broader LoI cap. attaching their PDF.

nina (Legal): ping link? I need to see exact redlines. LoI cap broadened to 2x ARR? that's high.

thomas (AE): https://files.nordicbank/procurement/redline_of_oa.pdf — they also added language forindemnity to include subcontractors and a clause requiring source-availability for models during POC.

kevin (SE): Regarding "source-availability": they probably mean model artifacts/weights access during the pilot. we can't provide model source. we can offer audited reproducible runtime + model checksum and container image sigs.

nina (Legal): ok we'll push back on source access. can we offer a WAF: allow runtime access logs + signed model artifacts for verification, not the weights. also need to address SCCs + explicit DPA reference.

leah (Finance): VAT: they want us to reverse-charge, invoice in EUR to the entity in Sweden. we need EU tax reg + VAT number on invoice. do we have a Swedish entity? if not, we need they to self-bill or provide local VAT guidance.

aya (Sales Ops): I'll prepare an order form with fields: customer entity, PO number, VAT number, remit-to. Also add a checkbox for "needs expedited countersign" so we can auto-escalate.

thomas (AE): timeline: customer expects countersigned order form within 48h after PO. can we meet that if legal + finance review today?

nina (Legal): I'll review redlines now. position: cap on liability stays at standard $5M; indemnity narrow to direct claims only; no source access. I'll put comments in the doc and propose alternate DPA language referencing EU SCCs.

kevin (SE): tech proposal to include in response (short):
```
- POC environment: reserved dedicated instances
- Key management: BYOK supported via AWS KMS / customer HSM for Private deployments
- Model verification: we provide signed container images, model checksum, and inference test vectors. weights/source code not provided.
- Logs: logs can be forwarded to customer-owned S3 in EU for retention control
```

leah (Finance): Net30 is fine but NordicBank requests Net45. we can accept Net45 for POC only if PO includes the billing contact and VAT details. also confirm if payments will be EUR or USD.

aya (Sales Ops): esign-bot: create draft envelope NB-PO-1934567890 with PO field, VAT field, remit-to sweden, reviewers: nina, leah, thomas.
esign-bot: draft created NB-PO-1934567890. reviewers added. envelope set to require customer PO before countersign.

thomas (AE): great. Nina/leah—can you both turn around reviews by EOD? if NordicBank insists on 2x ARR cap we escalate to revenue ops + exec.

nina (Legal): will do. if they insist on source access we'll decline and offer the signed verification option. will flag SCCs to Legal Ops; that may add 24-48h.

kevin (SE): i'll prepare the short technical appendix for the order form and paste here when ready.

leah (Finance): noted on VAT. if they self-bill we need signed confirmation from their AP. otherwise we remit invoice in USD with their VAT number and include reverse-charge note.

thomas (AE): thanks team. i'll run the 2pm CET sync with NordicBank and push for same-day PO. will update thread after the call. :thumbsup:
